subject: Next steps & activation checklist for MediCloud pilot (scope, owners, access)
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Rita Hernandez <rita@medicloud.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@medidata.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps & activation checklist for MediCloud pilot (scope, owners, access)

Thanks again, Rita — great conversation earlier. Summarizing what we discussed and the proposed kickoff plan so we have a single place to align. Please reply with any edits or if I mischaracterized anything.

Quick recap (pain + goals)
- Pain: High volume of support transcripts and clinical notes that are slow and expensive to classify; current pipeline has 18–24 hour batch turnaround and lots of manual triage.
- Goal: Reduce human review by >=60% for triage use case while keeping recall >95% for high-priority cases and p95 latency <300ms for served queries.

Proposed pilot (3 weeks) — scope and success metrics
- Scope: Ingest a sanitized subset of historical transcripts (~100k rows), run Redwood inference for intent classification + entity extraction, integrate outputs to a staging support dashboard for A/B review.
- Success metrics:
  * Automation rate >=60% (measured by reduction in manual triage tickets)
  * Classification precision >=92% and recall >=95% on the agreed eval set
  * p95 inference latency <=200ms in dedicated test pool under our target concurrency (10 qps)
  * Cost target: <=$0.025 per 1k tokens for inference during pilot (goal figure, subject to runtime config)

Owners (as discussed)
- Customer: Rita (product lead) — stakeholder for biz metrics and evaluation decisions
- Security/Compliance: Samir (will own SOC evidence and retention questions)
- Redwood: Mark (me) — engagement owner, commercial point; Aditya — runtime/onboarding; Laura — solutions & prompt evals; Jordan — data ingestion & pipeline connectors; Ben — SRE for dedicated pool config

Access & setup checklist (items for this week)
1) Customer to provision a sanitized sample dataset (S3 or Drive link) + data dictionary — target by Fri 11/27
2) Customer to provide SSO admin for team members or create service account for ingestion (<ritateam@medicloud.com> preferred)
3) Redwood to provide sandbox API key and dedicated test pool config (Aditya to provision)
4) Prompt set and eval spec (Laura) — draft by Mon 11/29; customer to confirm 6–8 seed prompts and gold labels
5) Wiring to staging dashboard — Jordan to share connector spec and runbook

Attachments: MediCloud_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (MMP with timeline & acceptance criteria), redwood-poc-template.pdf (pilot template)

Proposed dates
- Pilot kickoff (customer-facing): Monday, 12/6 — 30–45 minute alignment + access verification
- Internal engineering kickoff: Mon 11/29 (internal)

Next steps (please):
- Rita: confirm dataset location and point of contact for SSO/service account 
- Samir: confirm if SOC2 artifacts will be required for pilot or after POC
- All internal: Aditya/Laura/Jordan/Ben please scan the attached MMP and note any resource blockers by EOD Friday (11/27)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

—
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference

Thanks Markus — this captures the call well. A couple quick notes from our side:

1) Dataset: I can share a sanitized subset by tomorrow (11/26). Will upload to a secure S3 bucket and share access with the service account you provide.
2) Retention: We will need an explicit data retention window for the pilot artifacts — Samir will confirm but we expect 30 days default with the ability to purge on demand. Please call this out in the MMP.
3) Security: Samir is our internal security lead; he will send a short list of required artifacts (VPN/IP allowlist, SOC2 sections, encryption in transit) by Friday.

Pilot kickoff on 12/6 looks good from our side. Please add a brief internal pre-kickoff with your engs on 11/29 so we can ensure the API key & connector spec are ready.

Rita Hernandez

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Subject: Internal: MediCloud pilot — owners, immediate blockers, and kickoff prep

Team — quick internal follow-up after Rita's note. Core asks and assignments below. Please ping if anything is unclear.

Immediate deliverables (this week)
- Aditya: create sandbox API key + allocated test pool (small dedicated GPU profile) and share service account instructions. Target: Thu 11/26 EOD.
- Jordan: publish connector spec and example ingestion script for sanitized S3 payloads; include schema mapping and sample manifest. Target: Fri 11/27.
- Laura: draft prompt set (6–8 seed prompts) and evaluation rubric; include bias/edge-case tests. Target: Mon 11/29.
- Ben: confirm SRE runbook for sustaining p95 latency under 10 qps and a rollback plan if we see token-cost spike. Target: Mon 11/29.

Blockers: Rita flagged retention window — we should prepare a one-page retention approach and purge flow for Samir. Laura, can you add that to the eval doc as an appendix?

Kickoff schedule
- Internal sync (30 min): Mon 11/29 09:30–10:00 PT — invite to follow.
- Customer kickoff (45 min): Mon 12/6 10:00–10:45 PT — alignment + access validation

Links: Drive MMP (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c4d-medicloud-poc-plan), HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/MD-2026-1143)

If there are resource conflicts, call them out now so I can push timelines with Rita.

—
Markus

Got it — I will provision the sandbox creds and small dedicated test pool today. A couple notes:
- I will need an IAM/service-account email from Rita's team (prefer <ritateam@medicloud.com> or similar) to grant S3 access and map roles.
- For the latency target, I'll spin the pool with the 80GB A100 equivalent profile and a conservative batcher to start; if we miss p95 in smoke tests, we'll iterate quantization and batching.
- Flag: if we are asked to keep logs longer than 30 days for pilot telemetry, cost will increase — will call that out in the SRE runbook.

I can join the internal sync on Mon 11/29.
